implementation_notes: Depend on the upstream crate and use its types in your API. The compiler then makes the coupling literal and versioned, which is the honest form of conformity.
idiom_name: upstream crate types used directly in the signature
code_sketch:
use vendor_identity::Customer;

pub fn apply(c: &Customer) -> Result<(), ApplyError> { /* ... */ }
pitfalls: Newtype-wrapping the upstream type "for cleanliness", which is a translation layer
Depending on the upstream crate without pinning it, so the model shifts under you
